neighbours.label: the copula after a viewpoint adverb and its subject ('financially they are', 'personally I am'): the clause is framed as true in one respect
fire: The band sells out arenas, but musically they are stuck in the same three chords.
The twins look alike, yet emotionally they are very different people.
The village has grown rich, though politically it is still divided.
My parents have retired, and physically they are in better shape than ever.
The startup has many users, but commercially it is a failure so far.
We lost the match, but statistically we are the stronger side.
The islands are close to the mainland, but culturally they are a world apart.
The engine is old, but mechanically it is sound and easy to repair.
quiet: The band sells out arenas, but they are stuck in the same three chords.
The twins look alike, yet they are very different people.
The village has grown rich, though today it is still divided.
My parents have retired, and they are in better shape than ever.
The startup has many users, but it is a failure so far.
We lost the match, but we are the stronger side.
The islands are close to the mainland, but sometimes they are cut off by storms.
The engine is old, but it is sound and easy to repair.

notes: Card: ' are' / ' is' / ' am' / Korean topic marker 는 after frames like 'defensively they are', 'genetically they are', 'En lo personal estoy', '연령적으로는'. Probes: 'Financially they are' 0.68, 'defensively they are' 0.79, 'Personally I am' 0.36; the same clauses without the adverb 0.01. Near misses drop the adverb or use a time / manner adverb instead.
